faq.q: Is Webflow better for SEO than WordPress?
faq.a: Marginally, out of the box, because it is faster by default and has clean markup. A well-built WordPress site matches it. Platform is not what decides your rankings.

faq.q: Can I move from Webflow to WordPress later?
faq.a: Yes, but it is a rebuild rather than a migration - the content moves, the design does not. Choose deliberately rather than planning to switch.
Once you count maintenance honestly, they are closer than most comparisons suggest. WordPress wins on licence cost and loses on time.
